TI.P: on the appointment of the Vice-President of the European Central Bank

PREAMBLE.PREAMBLE.INIT: THE COUNCIL OF THE EUROPEAN UNION,

GR.VISA.VISA: Having regard to the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union, and in particular Articles 283(2) and 139(2) thereof,
Having regard to Protocol No 4 on the Statute of the European System of Central Banks and of the European Central Bank, and in particular Article 11.2 thereof,

PREAMBLE.PREAMBLE.FINAL: HEREBY RECOMMENDS TO THE EUROPEAN COUNCIL:

ENACTING.TERMS.P: To appoint Mr Luis DE GUINDOS JURADO as Vice-President of the European Central Bank for a term of office of eight years with effect from 1 June 2018.
